_comment: Nexus authors whose DDS2 mods the maintainers are happy to put in front of people.
Fetched by the manager and cached locally, so adding someone here reaches everyone without
shipping a new build of the app.
This list drives the Trusted Mods page - which mods get listed there, and nothing else.
It is NOT the same thing as verified-mods.json, and the two must not be confused:
verified-mods.json         GitHub ACCOUNTS. A security boundary - it decides how the update
prompt describes where a download is coming from.
trusted-nexus-authors.json NEXUS accounts. A recommendation. It decides whose mods appear on
a browsing page. Nothing is downloaded or installed from it, and
it makes no claim about any individual file.
Being listed here means the maintainers know this author's work and think it is worth finding.
It does not mean every mod they publish has been read, and it never will - people publish
faster than anyone can review. Users still download from Nexus and judge for themselves.
name     required. Nexus username, exactly as it appears on their profile URL.
addedBy  optional. Who added the entry, so a stale one can be chased up.
